searchText: Hey everyone, if you are new to zk tech, we(Chao) have made a separate ZKstudy discord to learn / discuss our dumb or not so dumb questions about zkSync. Basically we are new to ZKtech wanna learn about it, share resources and discuss stuff, rather together than separately, anybody welcome to join! https://discord.gg/ws3z3ptR welcome! depending on your level of experience, you might be interested in 0xPARCs applied zK Learning Group https://twitter.com/0xPARC/status/1458908334069727235?s=20 thanks this looks interesting ❤️ OxPARC the name has some resemblance with Xerox PARC i think that's the intention!
